subject: For your return: the Criminal Mind writer pass 001, scene 3 as take 2 with its sound page, the audit of the 165 shots and the Grok placeholders, the cast dependency ledger, the first Grok request prepared; nothing asked of your lane now
body: For your return, the Criminal Mind side of today: your Preliminary pass is read in structure and in part by card and kept as take 1 on your 165 ids; my pass (attached) adds the reading, the grammar, the author questions and the audit; scene 3 is written as take 2 (attached) as the first proof sequence, dialogue first, with the sound page for the scratch read that your lane needs before any timing; the Grok team's placeholders are audited (keep, change or scrap per shot in the audit table) and indexed in the cast dependency ledger so a casting change regenerates by list; the first image requests (attached) are prepared for Ziggy to hand to the Grok team under the hold. The excerpt hashes in my 11.1 lines use the same convention as your cards (the readable text's lines with carriage returns removed, joined by newlines, no terminating newline); the four scene 3 values reproduce yours exactly. The executable package, the bindings, the route and the result loop stay yours; nothing here asks you to run anything.

attachments.description: The writer's first pass on The Criminal Mind: the story as read and the audience ladder; the adaptation grammar (one face, three states; the phone; the reflections; the flash inserts; the time layers; dialogue first; the era; the rating; shot identity; placeholders; the casting breadcrumbs); fifteen questions for Baldadoon, none repaired; the audit of the 165 Preliminary shots and of the Grok team's placeholders; the first image requests; screen length, the two technical gates and the order of writing. Proposal; nothing selected or run.

Scene 3, the first blocked call, TCM-03-01 to TCM-03-04 as the writer's take 2 beside CFA Nova's take 1: sections 0 to 7, 7b and 11 per shot, the scene's sound page for the scratch read, the placeholder verdicts (the car interior L10 in place of the cover's exterior L01; base C01 as the placeholder face) and the cast dependency. The first proof sequence; no run requested.

One row per shot: visible participants (the Grok roster trimmed), off-screen voices, the Jack and Johnny state and surface, time layer, set-family fit, the writer's verdict on the starter set image, continuity props, missing inserts, split issues, design seconds, rating flags, the story questions touched, and the card issues found.

The reverse index from every placeholder face and set image to the shots and images that depend on it, seeded from the Grok beat table for all 165 shots and from the scene 3 cards; append only; when a role is cast, the other candidates' rows are the regeneration list.

The first batch of stills requested of the Grok team for the two proof gates (John's wardrobe set; the car interior with him seated; two phone inserts; the ambulance pass plate; the reflection test), prepared for Ziggy to hand over; the generation hold is his to lift.

source: CFA Nova's resume note and Preliminary pass of October 30; the Grok team's hand-off of October 31; Ziggy's direction of October 31.
